ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via Outlook Home Page
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects potential persistence activity via outlook home page.
An attacker can set a home page to achieve code execution and persistence by editing the WebView registry keys.

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\WebView\\\\.*")) AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\URL$"))
